The quotation describes a government-funded free courses programme targeting engineering and manufacturing skills. The core mechanism is subsidised vocational training (free courses) directed at specific industrial sectors (engineering and manufacturing) to address labour supply/skills gaps.

- Primary: **I2** (Education and Research Institutions — vocational/adult education provision)
- Secondary: **J2** (Demand and Supply of Labor — skills supply for specific occupations) and **L6** (Industry Studies: Manufacturing — sector-specific focus)
